scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoints and exact Lean proof source for local theorems with no Physlib physics counterpart. Hash and compiled-name checks detect drift and provenance errors; they are not automatic symbolic translation or numerical validation.

operators.formula_latex: V_{set} = - \frac{\gamma T k_{B}}{\alpha_{F}} + \frac{E_{m} - T k_{B} \log{\left(\frac{T g_{r} k_{B} \nu_{0}}{\alpha_{F}} \right)}}{\alpha_{F}}

interpretations: Energies (Phi_Bn, E_m) are in joules, T in kelvin, k_B and q_e exact SI; an energy in eV read as joules gives a wrong result by a factor 1.6e-19. The theorems hold in any coherent unit embedding.

apply_conductance_drift is G_0 (t_d/t_{d,0})^(-nu) for positive times inside the fitted range; the drift exponent is minus the slope of log G against log t_d at every time and does not depend on the reference time.

emit_thermionic_conductance is the zero-bias small-signal slope of the three-dimensional Richardson-Dushman current of one contact with ideality factor 1; with an ideality factor n the slope is G/n for I_s (exp(q_e V/(n k_B T)) - 1) and G for I_s exp(q_e V/(n k_B T)) (1 - exp(-q_e V/(k_B T))).
zero_bias_retention is the mean of the exponential exit time of one path at the Arrhenius rate nu_0 exp(-E_m/(k_B T)); M equivalent paths divide it by M.

ramp_set_voltage is the mean of the minimum-Gumbel law of the first hop under a linear ramp with dwell g_r per volt, the hop rate nu_0 exp(-(E_m - alpha_F V)/(k_B T)) and the hops at zero and negative bias neglected; the neglected expected count is g_r k_B T/(alpha_F tau_ret).

propagate_programming_error is the per-cell model of the catalog description (affine mapping, positive and negative column groups, binary inputs with E[x^2] = 1/2, independent unbiased cell errors of coefficient of variation c) written with the kernel moments n_w, w_max, S_1 = sum |w_i| and S_2 = sum w_i^2 of the nonzero weights.

dissipate_pulse_energy is V_p^2 G t_p for a conductance constant during the pulse; for a conductance that changes monotonically the dissipated energy lies between its values at the initial and the final conductance.
contract_device_conductance is the uniform-channel conductance; for segments in series it is an upper bound when sigma is the length-averaged conductivity.
